root: ^You want my expert insight? Well, here it is: I got here last night, didn’t see a damn thing, and I like to think I’d notice a murder happening in the middle of the road. He shrugs.

^Alright, tough crowd. Well, if you ever wanna investigate some good deals, my shop’s open. Dead or alive, everyone’s a customer.
